ex.en: Contact your card issuer if your card is lost.
ex.zh: 卡片遺失時，請聯絡發卡銀行。

ex.en: The bond issuer must pay interest every year.
ex.zh: 債券發行人每年必須支付利息。

ex.en: The issuance of new shares raised two million dollars.
ex.zh: 發行新股募得兩百萬美元。

ex.en: Visa issuance usually takes five working days.
ex.zh: 簽證核發通常需要五個工作天。

ex.en: Many elderly people suffer from isolation.
ex.zh: 很多長者飽受孤單之苦。

ex.en: Working from home can lead to a sense of isolation.
ex.zh: 在家工作可能會讓人有孤立感。

ex.en: The patient was kept in isolation for two weeks.
ex.zh: 那名病患被隔離了兩週。

ex.en: Travelers had to stay in isolation at a hotel.
ex.zh: 旅客必須在飯店隔離。

ex.en: Several cottages have been isolated by the flood water.
ex.zh: 好幾間小屋被洪水圍困，與外界隔絕。

ex.en: Patients with the virus were isolated from others.
ex.zh: 感染病毒的病人被隔離了。

ex.en: Working from home made him feel isolated.
ex.zh: 在家工作讓他覺得很孤立。

ex.en: Engineers isolated the cause of the problem.
ex.zh: 工程師找出了問題的原因。

ex.en: We need to isolate the faulty part.
ex.zh: 我們需要找出故障的零件。

ex.en: Seen from a plane, that island is very beautiful.
ex.zh: 從飛機上看，那座島非常美。

ex.en: No one lived on the island at that time.
ex.zh: 那時候島上沒有人住。

ex.en: A massive earthquake of magnitude 8.8 hit the Japanese islands today.
ex.zh: 今天，規模 8.8 的強烈地震侵襲了日本列島。

ex.en: We have issues we have to deal with.
ex.zh: 我們有一些必須處理的問題。

ex.en: This issue has nothing to do with you.
ex.zh: 這件事跟你無關。

ex.en: She has dropped out of school due to health issues.
ex.zh: 她因為健康問題休學了。

ex.en: The meteorological bureau has issued a red rainstorm alert.
ex.zh: 氣象局發布了豪雨紅色警報。

ex.en: The magazine is issued twice a month.
ex.zh: 這本雜誌每個月出刊兩次。
